stories.title: Reportan que Maduro y Cilia Flores enfrentarán nuevos cargos; serán acusados de presuntas torturas a estadounidenses

en.title: Maduro and Cilia Flores reported to face new charges; accused of alleged torture of Americans
en.summary: Venezuelan officials Maduro and Cilia Flores are facing additional criminal charges related to alleged torture of American citizens, with sources indicating the charges could extend to other individuals.

stories.title: Fiscalía CDMX duplicará cantidad de policías de investigación en búsqueda de personas: Brugada; ayudará a que cada elemento atienda menos casos

en.title: Mexico City Prosecutor's Office to double number of investigation police in search for missing persons: Brugada; will help each officer handle fewer cases
en.summary: The Mexico City Prosecutor's Office plans to double its investigative police force to improve efforts in locating missing persons, with financial transfers already underway to support the new hiring.

stories.title: Morena celebra XV años al ritmo de Eugenia León, palabras de AMLO y Sheinbaum; Ariadna Montiel cerrará evento

en.title: Morena celebrates 15 years to the rhythm of Eugenia León, words from AMLO and Sheinbaum; Ariadna Montiel will close event
en.summary: Mexico's Morena party marked its 15th anniversary with a celebration featuring musical performances, speeches from political leaders including President AMLO and Sheinbaum, and commemorative videos.

stories.title: Agreden a policías en operativo de recuperación de espacios en el Centro Histórico; hay 7 detenidos

en.title: Police attacked during operation to recover public spaces in Historic Center; 7 detained
en.summary: Seven men aged 21 to 29 were arrested after attacking police officers during an operation to reclaim public spaces in Mexico City's Historic Center.

stories.title: Diputados de Morena en riesgo de no llegar a festejo por 15 años del partido; Monreal prioriza sesión este miércoles

en.title: Morena Deputies at Risk of Missing Party's 15-Year Celebration; Monreal Prioritizes Wednesday Session
en.summary: Morena's coordinator in Congress stated that the party's lawmakers will remain in a parliamentary session rather than attend the party's 15-year anniversary celebration scheduled for Wednesday.

stories.title: Caen 7 por agredir a policías en Motolinia, Centro Histórico

en.title: Seven Arrested for Assaulting Police Officers in Motolinia, Historic Center
en.summary: Seven men were detained after assaulting police officers during an operation to remove motorcycles parked illegally in the Historic Center of the city.

stories.title: Tras muerte de Maricarmen Abascal, sindicatos españoles llaman a huelga general; exigen mejores salarios y vivienda digna

en.title: Following Maricarmen Abascal's Death, Spanish Unions Call for General Strike; Demand Better Wages and Decent Housing
en.summary: Spanish unions have called for a general strike scheduled for November 11 to demand improved wages and adequate housing conditions for workers.

stories.title: Tribunal Electoral da revés al INE; boletas "planchadas" impiden vincularlas con un voto, considera

en.title: Electoral Court Rejects INE Position; "Straight" Ballots Prevent Linking Them to a Single Vote, Court Determines
en.summary: Mexico's Electoral Court ruling established that the legally required ballot procedure includes receiving, marking, folding, and depositing ballots in the urn as separate steps.

stories.title: Da TEPJF revés a INE por 'boletas planchadas'

en.title: Electoral Court Overturns INE Agreement on 'Planchadas' Ballots
en.summary: Mexico's electoral court reversed an INE decision that would have prevented the invalidation of oversized ballots at polling stations.

stories.title: Murió Maricarmen Abascal, octogenaria símbolo de las protestas por la vivienda en España

en.title: Maricarmen Abascal, 87-Year-Old Housing Protest Symbol in Spain, Dies
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction from her Madrid apartment sparked widespread housing protests in Spain has died.

stories.title: Murió Maricarmen, mujer cuyo desalojo impulsó protestas

en.title: Maricarmen, Woman Whose Eviction Sparked Protests, Dies
en.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, a symbol of Spain's anti-eviction movement, died at age 87.

stories.title: Morena cumple 15 años; AMLO no acudirá al festejo

en.title: Morena Marks 15 Years; AMLO Will Not Attend Celebration
en.summary: Mexico's Morena party is holding a 15th anniversary event at the National Auditorium with party founders and elected officials, though the president will not attend.

stories.title: Golpe a los centros de datos de Google: gobierno detiene dos de sus grandes obras en Finlandia

en.title: Google data centers hit: government halts two major projects in Finland
en.summary: Finnish authorities suspended two Google technology projects due to concerns about their environmental impact, pending completion of investigations.

stories.title: Nobel de Química explica por qué algunas moléculas toman una sola forma y cómo esto ayuda a crear fármacos

en.title: Chemistry Nobel laureate explains why certain molecules take a single form and how this aids drug creation
en.summary: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai addressed a century-old chemical mystery by explaining how homochirality can spontaneously emerge in molecules.

stories.title: Cuando el trabajo consume más de lo que produce

en.title: When work consumes more than it produces
en.summary: Workplace burnout often stems not from excessive hours but from spending time on shifting priorities, reversed decisions, and unproductive tasks.

stories.title: Salud o economía: el falso dilema empieza en el salón de clases

en.title: Health or economy: the false dilemma begins in the classroom
en.summary: Companies need employees who can navigate tensions between competing legitimate interests, a skill that educational systems typically underemphasize.

stories.title: CFE alerta que tu refrigerador se come 24% de tu recibo de luz, pero reducir consumo te costaría 40,000 pesos con IA

en.title: CFE alerts that your refrigerator consumes 24% of your electricity bill, but reducing consumption would cost you 40,000 pesos with AI
en.summary: Refrigerators account for approximately one-quarter of household electricity consumption. While AI-equipped models promise to reduce consumption by up to 15%, such intelligent refrigerators carry significantly higher prices.
